headline_stat.name: fraction of active CA1 pyramidal cells with a significant place field (per direction, Achilles)

stated_limitation: Two caveats. Spike sorting and the cell-type labels are used as published without re-curation, so some units may be merges or splits. And because the animal pauses at the reward zones, fields at the track ends could partly reflect reward or immobility rather than position alone; the interior fields, which make up most of the population, do not have this ambiguity.

justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 (Grosmark & Buzsáki dorsal CA1 on a linear track) is the canonical place-cell dataset, an expert's obvious choice.
justification.handling: Real NWB files streamed from S3, with explicit pyramidal-cell selection, 5 cm/s speed threshold, direction-split laps derived correctly from the NaN-gapped linearized trace.
justification.analysis: Skaggs SI against a 500-iteration per-unit circular-shift null, split-half stability, lap-blocked cross-validated Bayesian decoding, and a B-spline Poisson GLM all converge, with the required controls present.
justification.correctness: Every headline number (0.85 place-cell stability, 5.2 Hz peak, 0.32 m width, 6.8-11.9 cm decoding error) reproduces exactly from the committed CSVs and is internally consistent across figures.
justification.figures: Figures are clearly labeled with units and sample sizes, and the population rate-map band, SI-vs-null scatter, and decoding confusion matrix make the effect immediately visible with representative examples.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate to a genuinely strong result, the 0.85 vs 0.76 denominators are used consistently, and specific limitations (uncurated sorting, reward-zone/end-field ambiguity) are named plainly.
